function: Channel extrapolation: learned BS-antenna/RIS-element selection, quantization repair (SRNet, CRNet) and reference-based VAE extrapolating partial to full BS-RIS and user-BS channels (p. 4)
system: Multi-user mmWave MIMO: 32-antenna cylindrical-array BS, hybrid RIS of 64 elements (few active, low-resolution ADCs), 4 single-antenna users, 28 GHz (p. 8)
method: Supervised deep learning: Gumbel-softmax selection network, CNN repair networks (SRNet, CRNet), reference-based VGG/VAE extrapolation network; offline training in three phases, NMSE loss (p. 7)
data_channel: DeepMIMO 'O1' ray-tracing scenario at 28 GHz: 20000 multi-user samples and 2000 RIS samples plus reference samples; 80% training, 20% validation (p. 9)
test_conditions: Same DeepMIMO O1 data: 80% of samples train, 20% held-out validation; evaluation sweeps SNR 10-30 dB, compression rates, ADC bits; no unseen scenario (p. 9)
baselines: Own variants only: uniform selection vs learned selection, and LS estimate before SRNet/CRNet; no earlier classical or learned extrapolation method compared (p. 10)
metrics: NMSE (dB) of extrapolated channels (whole, BS-RIS common, multi-user) and of partial-space estimates, versus compression rates, SNR (10-30 dB) and ADC bits (p. 9)
complexity: FLOPs given per network (e.g. SRNet: (40Cs+72Cs^2)*Ntilde*(L+PT)); Big-O: SRNet O(Ntilde(L+PT)), CRNet and extrapolation network O((N+P)M) (p. 8)
q1_support: p. 8: "The DeepMIMO dataset [54] is widely used in deep learning applications for massive MIMO systems. Hence, it is utilized in this paper to generate channel samples"
q2_support: p. 9: "We employ 80% of the dataset for training and the rest for validation"; "all the results are based on the validation set" (held-out part of the same data; SNR, ADC-bit and compression-rate sweeps only).
q3_support: p. 9: "The effectiveness of the selection network is verified by comparing it with the performance of the uniform selection"; p. 10: "represent the NMSE of the estimation that directly feeds" the LS estimator. Only ablations of its own modules; no earlier learned method or standard network is compared.
q4_support: p. 8: "The number of floating points operations (FLOPs) for the SRNet is" (40Cs+72Cs^2)*Ntilde*(L+PT), with FLOPs for the CRNet and the VAE blocks and Big-O orders.
q5_support: p. 8: "The DeepMIMO dataset [54] is widely used in deep learning applications for massive MIMO systems. Hence, it is utilized in this paper to generate channel samples"; public channel dataset used, but the authors give no link to their own code.
notes: Include, area 2: the learned networks estimate and extrapolate the channel (p. 4). Sec.
